high_level_description: This image is a split-screen meme that commemorates John Cena's career in WWE. The top half of the image shows two wrestlers facing each other in what appears to be a pre-match moment at an event. The text overlay reads "JOHN CENA WWE DEBUT" with the date "JUNE 27, 2002," indicating the beginning of his professional wrestling career.
